android.desc:
Recovering from a C-section? Gentle recovery for the week you are in.

MatraBloom gives you 5 to 20 minute guided workouts matched to how your baby was born, a quick daily check-in for how you feel, and plain answers to the questions new mothers ask at 3am.

Made for C-section recovery

A caesarean is major abdominal surgery, and MatraBloom treats it that way. Tell it how your baby was born and it follows a gentler C-section path: breathing and pelvic floor work from the start, each movement opening on a C-section timeline, gentle cardio only when your week allows, and no crunches or sit-ups. Had a vaginal birth or a VBAC? MatraBloom follows your path too.

Personal postpartum recovery, week by week

MatraBloom asks about your baby's birth date, how your baby was born, your goals and concerns, your energy, how long you can move for and what equipment you have. It builds a personal session for your current postpartum week and rebuilds it as the weeks go by, because week 3 and week 12 are not the same week.

Guided postnatal workouts at home

- 32 gentle movements, each with a short video tutorial
- A guided player that counts each movement, builds in rest, and lets you pause when the baby needs you
- Breathing, pelvic floor exercises (kegels), gentle mobility, core reconnection and everyday strength
- A two-minute reset of breathing and pelvic floor work for the days you have nothing left
- After each workout, say how it felt and later sessions adjust

Pelvic floor, core and diastasis recti

Core recovery after birth starts with breath, not crunches. Sessions are built around that, and the articles explain pelvic floor care, C-section scar care and diastasis recti (the tummy gap after pregnancy) in plain language.

Daily recovery support

- A daily check-in for mood, energy and confidence, one tap from home
- A bloom streak that grows with your check-ins and forgives one missed day a week
- A movement streak with two rest days a week, a weekly goal of 2 to 5 sessions, and milestones
- Gentle reminders at the time you choose
- A 52-week recovery timeline in 6 stages, with a chart of how you have been feeling
- A private journal for the thoughts you are not ready to say out loud
- A 7-question emotional check-in for your own awareness, with places to find support (it is not a test or a diagnosis)
- 23 articles on C-section recovery, postpartum exercise, pelvic floor care, diastasis recti, nutrition, breastfeeding, baby blues,

quotes.title: I built a postpartum recovery app after reading many stories from new mothers
